inputs.goal: Add a paginate helper to src/list.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `paginate<T>(items: readonly T[], page: number, size: number): T[]` in src/list.ts. Pages are numbered from 1: page 1 is the first `size` items, page 2 the next `size`, and a page past the end is an empty array. A page or size below 1 throws a RangeError. Add tests.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Add `paginate` beside `chunk` in src/list.ts: validate page and size, compute the offset of the requested 1-based page and slice.
2. Add tests in src/list.test.ts for the first pages, a page past the end and the RangeError cases.
inputs.implementation_summary: Added `paginate(items, page, size)` to src/list.ts with 1-based pages, validation that throws a RangeError for a page or size below 1, and tests for normal pages, a page past the end and the invalid arguments. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
